pois.name: Mushroom (ASHES vent field)
pois.note: Coordinate is the OOI RS03ASHS site position (45.9337 N, -130.0139 W, 1,552 m per OOI; this tile's grid reads 1,540.1 m at that point, within GMRT's ~43x61 m cell resolution). Interactive Oceans states the CAMHDS301 HD camera sits at Mushroom, so this is Mushroom's own monitored position, not an approximation. Mushroom is described as ~4 m tall with orifice temperatures over 275 degC and largely unchanged in size since the late 1980s; depth_m is set 4 m above the seabed reading. The chimney itself is a placed reconstruction: the field (about 2,826 sq m, per Wikipedia) is about the area of one grid cell, so no individual chimney is resolved in the real terrain.

pois.name: Inferno (ASHES vent field)
pois.note: UW/OOI places Inferno about 10 m from Mushroom without publishing a bearing. This scan marker shares the prop’s 0.00009 degree (~10 m) northward offset. The bearing is authored; the marker snaps to the terrain.

pois.name: Hell, Phoenix and Virgin chimneys
pois.note: Hell, Phoenix and Virgin are real named ASHES structures, generally under 4 m tall with several narrow discharge orifices each (UW Interactive Oceans); Virgin Mound is a separate sub-metre anhydrite spire venting some of the caldera's most CO2-rich fluid. None has a published coordinate, so this POI is placed illustratively about 40 m from Mushroom, within the field's roughly 2,826 sq m extent (Wikipedia), representing the field's smaller chimneys as a cluster rather than three separate points.

pois.name: Base of the western caldera wall
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain, about 288 m west of Mushroom: the seabed rises here from ~1,540 m to ~1,416 m, a slope consistent with the caldera's western boundary fault -- OOI states ASHES sits 'near the base of the western caldera wall' and 'about 130 m east of the caldera boundary fault' (the exact fault trace itself is not resolved at this tile's ~43-61 m cell size, so this POI marks the rising wall terrain rather than a specific scarp line).
